mapper.sql: SELECT f.repair_id, f.repair_no, f.company_id, f.task_id, f.company_name, f.system_type_id, f.system_type_name, f.equipment_id, f.equipment_name, f.found_time, f.is_reported, f.urgency_level, f.fault_description, f.fault_images, f.reporter_name, f.reporter_phone, f.reporter_id, f.customer_address, f.repair_status, f.repair_user_id, f.repair_person, f.repair_phone, f.dispatch_by, f.dispatch_time, f.accept_time, f.start_time, f.complete_time, f.repair_description, f.repair_images, f.status, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, ru.user_name AS repair_user_name, ru.login_name AS repair_user_login FROM fire_fault_repair f LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = f.repair_user_id AND ru.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('BX', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(repair_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM fire_fault_repair WHERE repair_no LIKE CONCAT('BX', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
